Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle provide digital creators with a platform to sell their products, manage orders, and process payments. However, their services come with a caveat: they operate in limited countries, and their payment processing fees can be exorbitant. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows digital creators to design, document, and deploy their own digital stores without relying on third-party platforms. With COREMERCH, creators have full control over their data, payment processing, and product delivery, making it an attractive alternative for those in restricted countries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving a significant number of countries without access to their services. PayPal's account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, further complicating matters for creators in restricted countries. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also have limitations on country support. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a fully functional digital store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, making it a viable solution for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge high transaction fees, ranging from 2.9% + 30 cents to 3.4% + 30 cents per transaction. Gumroad charges 3.5% + 30 cents per sale, while Lemon Squeezy charges 2.9% + 30 cents per transaction. Paddle charges 2.9% + 30 cents per transaction, with a 10% charge for payments exceeding $10,000. In contrast, COREMERCH's NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making it a more cost-effective option for creators.

Additionally, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) comes with 30-day support, ensuring that creators have a reliable partner to help them with any technical issues.
